create_date_range: create a DatetimeIndex with a fixed frequency of equally spaced time points between start and end dates
create_bdate_range: create a DatetimeIndex with business day frequency that skips weekends and optional holidays
build_datetimeindex_tz_convert: build a timezone-aware DatetimeIndex and convert it from one time zone to another
build_datetimeindex_tz_localize: build a timezone-naive DatetimeIndex and localize it to a specified time zone
test_datetimeindex_snap: test snapping DatetimeIndex timestamps to the nearest occurrence of a specified frequency
